reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Invalidation of anticipatory lien waivers
headings.reviewNote: Declares anticipatory agreements waiving mechanic's lien rights in consideration of contract award void against public policy, preserving subordination and release.

headings.title: Conditional payment lien waivers permitted
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory invalidation does not prohibit contractual provisions requiring lien waivers as condition of payment.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1992 enactment note; confirmed public-policy invalidation of anticipatory lien waivers (preserving subordination/release) and permissibility of payment-conditioned lien waivers.

headings.title: Mechanic's lien creation, property scope, and acreage limits
headings.reviewNote: Grants mechanic's lien on buildings, improvements, and land up to three acres or full commercial lots with roadway access.

headings.title: Rental machinery and equipment lien requirements
headings.reviewNote: Limits rental machinery or equipment liens to commercial property claims over $5,000 with written owner notice within fifteen business days of commenced use, exempting contractors using rented equipment.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections, prior revisions, and 1972/2008 case annotations (Union Reddi-Mix on municipal property; Collins & Hermann); retained titles and fixed subsection 2 note from 'advance notice' to notice within 15 business days of commenced use.

headings.title: Mandatory original contractor disclosure notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires original contractor to deliver bold ten-point lien disclosure notice prior to receiving payment.

headings.title: Disclosure notice as condition precedent to lien
headings.reviewNote: Establishes timely delivery of written disclosure notice as condition precedent to original contractor mechanic's lien.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for notice failure and fraudulent waivers
headings.reviewNote: Imposes class B misdemeanor penalty for fraudulent failure to give notice and class D felony for fraudulent waivers or affidavits.

headings.title: Exception for insured new residence construction
headings.reviewNote: Exempts new residences with title insurance company mechanic's lien protection from notice requirements.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for settlement agent fraudulent waiver acceptance
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class D felony for settlement agent knowingly accepting fraudulent lien waiver or false affidavit for financial gain.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections (including 10-point bold Notice to Owner) and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); confirmed condition precedent, criminal penalties, title-insured new-residence exception, and settlement-agent felony.

headings.title: Applicability limited to owner-occupied residential repair
headings.reviewNote: Applies section exclusively to repair, remodeling, or additions to owner-occupied residential property of four units or less.

headings.title: Written owner consent requirement for subcontractor liens
headings.reviewNote: Requires separate signed bold ten-point owner consent contract as prerequisite for non-contractor liens.

headings.title: Notice retention and attachment to recorded lien
headings.reviewNote: Requires contractor to retain and furnish notice copy and mandates attaching signed consent to recorded lien claim.

headings.title: Defense of full or partial payment to contractor
headings.reviewNote: Establishes full payment to original contractor as complete defense and partial payment as pro tanto offset.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for forged or fraudulent consent
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class D felony penalties for falsifying owner signatures or issuing fraudulent consent documents.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections (including 10-point bold Consent of Owner) and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); confirmed owner-occupied 4-unit repair scope, consent attachment, payment defense/offset, and class D felony.

headings.title: Offense of lien fraud by nonpaying contractor
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of lien fraud for failing to pay subcontractors or suppliers after receiving payment with intent to defraud.

headings.title: Property owner claim against nonpaying contractor
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes property owner paying subcontractors to recover against nonpaying original contractor or supplier.

headings.title: Felony and misdemeanor penalty thresholds
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class D felony for lien fraud exceeding 500 dollars and class A misdemeanor for lesser amounts or unfiled liens.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); confirmed lien fraud offense, owner/lessee claim against nonpaying contractor, and $500 class D felony vs class A misdemeanor thresholds.

headings.title: Design professional lien creation and acreage limits
headings.reviewNote: Grants mechanic's liens to landscape architects, architects, engineers, and land surveyors up to three acres or full town lots.

headings.title: Well-digging labor and machinery liens
headings.reviewNote: Grants mechanic's lien up to three acres for labor, materials, or machinery furnished to dig water wells.

headings.title: Building demolition and razing liens
headings.reviewNote: Grants mechanic's lien up to three acres or town lots for labor or materials used in demolishing or razing buildings.

headings.title: Application of general mechanic's lien procedures
headings.reviewNote: Applies general mechanic's lien procedures in §§ 429.030–429.060 and §§ 429.080–429.430 to subsections 1–3; source note flags § 429.430 repealed by H.B. 1634 (1978).

headings.title: Prerequisite conditions for design professional liens
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes design professional liens before actual construction begins if contracted directly with owner or lessee.

headings.title: Priority and pro rata distribution with other mechanic's liens
headings.reviewNote: Determines priority between design professionals and other mechanic's lien claimants on pro rata basis under section 429.260.

headings.title: Owner and lessee defenses against design professional claims
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes owner defenses asserting noncompliance with professional services contract, impracticability, or economic infeasibility.

headings.title: Requirement of written agreement
headings.reviewNote: Requires professional services agreement to be in writing.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all eight subsections, repealed-section footnote (§ 429.430 repealed 1978) in subsection 4, and 1978/1992 annotations (Marsh; In re Branson Mall); confirmed design professional, well-digging, demolition, priority, defense, and writing headings.

headings.title: Applicability limited to residential real property
headings.reviewNote: Restricts section application to residential real property, excluding owner-occupied repair or remodeling governed by section 429.013.

headings.title: Definition of residential real property
headings.reviewNote: Defines residential real property to include four-unit dwellings, condominiums, and townhouses, excluding mixed-use parcels.

headings.title: Claimant duty to record notice of rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires claimants to record notice of rights at least five calendar days before intended closing date.

headings.title: Relief from duty for identified claimants
headings.reviewNote: Relieves claimant of recording duty if accurately identified in previously recorded notice of rights.

headings.title: Weekend or legal holiday deadline extension
headings.reviewNote: Extends notice recording deadline falling on weekend or holiday to next business day.

headings.title: Forfeiture of lien rights for failure to record
headings.reviewNote: Establishes waiver and forfeiture of mechanic's lien rights for failure to record notice of rights while preserving other legal remedies.

headings.title: Ineffectiveness of notice recorded after bona fide conveyance
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates notice of rights recorded after property conveyance to bona fide purchaser for value.

headings.title: Required statutory form and contents for notice of rights
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes statutory form, execution, notarization, and identification standards for notice of rights.

headings.title: Recording location in county land records
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice of rights to be recorded in recorder of deeds office in county where property is situated.

headings.title: Recorder duties and indexing standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs recorder of deeds to index owners as grantors and claimants as grantees without requiring owner signature.

headings.title: Owner notice of intended sale recording and posting
headings.reviewNote: Governs owner recording, posting, and transmitting notice of intended sale at least forty-five days prior to closing.

headings.title: Non-extension of lien filing deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that recording notice of rights does not extend mechanic's lien filing deadlines under section 429.080.

headings.title: Separate parcel recording and subdivision tracts
headings.reviewNote: Requires separate notice for each parcel but permits single notice for multi-lot common ownership or pre-platting tracts.

headings.title: Exemption from section 429.100 ten-day notice
headings.reviewNote: Relieves claimants from section 429.100 notice while retaining general statutory compliance duties.

headings.title: Mechanic's lien statement contents and notice attachment
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates required claimant disclosures in mechanic's lien statement and mandates attaching file-stamped notice of rights.

headings.title: Lien forfeiture for prejudicial notice errors
headings.reviewNote: Provides for forfeiture of mechanic's lien rights to the extent errors in notice of rights prejudice owners, lenders, or purchasers.

headings.title: Release of lien by deposit of substitute collateral
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes property release from lien upon depositing cash, letter of credit, or surety bond at 150 percent of lien amount.

headings.title: Surety company liability on substitute bond
headings.reviewNote: Obligates surety to pay any judgment entered under section 429.210 up to penal sum of bond.

headings.title: Bank liability on substitute letter of credit
headings.reviewNote: Obligates issuing bank to pay judgment under section 429.210 up to amount of letter of credit.

headings.title: Transfer of claimant rights to substitute collateral
headings.reviewNote: Transfers claimant lien rights from residential property to deposited substitute collateral upon release.

headings.title: Court order for disposition of substitute collateral
headings.reviewNote: Directs court, upon determining claim against substitute collateral, to order clerk payment, bank letter-of-credit payment, surety judgment, or collateral release.

headings.title: Preservation of claimant burden and priority rules
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that substitute collateral deposit affects only recovery source without altering priority or proof requirements.

headings.title: Retention of claimant liability for slander of title
headings.reviewNote: Preserves claimant potential liability for slander of title notwithstanding lien release through substitute collateral.

headings.title: Joinder of surety or bank in enforcement action
headings.reviewNote: Requires surety company or issuing bank to be joined as party to mechanic's lien enforcement action.

headings.title: Partial or full mechanic's lien waivers
headings.reviewNote: Regulates conditional and unconditional mechanic's lien waivers and limits waivers for less than amount claimed.

headings.title: Legal effect of unconditional final lien waiver
headings.reviewNote: Establishes unconditional final waiver as complete bar to lien rights including remedial or additional work.

headings.title: Statutory form for unconditional final lien waiver
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes statutory form, execution, and signing date format for unconditional final lien waiver.

headings.title: Limitation of unconditional waiver to lien rights
headings.reviewNote: Limits legal effect of unconditional final waiver to lien rights without releasing underlying contractual remedies.

headings.title: Enforceability of unconditional waiver despite nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Enforces unconditional final lien waiver against claimant lien rights despite nonpayment of promised consideration.

headings.title: Duty to execute final waiver upon full payment
headings.reviewNote: Requires claimant paid in full to execute waiver within five days or face slander of title liability and 500 dollar penalty.

headings.title: Application date to conveyances closing on or after November 1, 2010
headings.reviewNote: Applies provisions of section to residential real property conveyances closing on or after November 1, 2010.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all thirty-one subsections (including embedded Notice of Rights and Unconditional Final Lien Waiver form tables) and 2010 enactment note; retained titles and aligned subsection 21 note with mandatory 'shall' judicial disposition.

headings.title: Partial release of multi-parcel mechanic's liens
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes lien claimants to release individual lots or parcels from multi-tract mechanic's liens upon specifying attributed debt.

headings.title: Acknowledgment and statutory form for partial release
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuit-clerk record or margin acknowledgment of partial release and provides statutory form table; source note flags 'be' appears in original rolls.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections, embedded Partial Release form table, and original-rolls footnote ('be' in subsection 2 form); confirmed multi-parcel partial release and circuit-clerk acknowledgment headings.

headings.title: Buildings and machinery on leased land subject to lien
headings.reviewNote: Subjects buildings, improvements, and machinery on leased land to liens regardless of lessee removal rights.

headings.title: Lien on leasehold interest and erected improvements
headings.reviewNote: Grants lien on buildings, machinery, and leasehold term for labor or materials furnished to licensee or lessee.

headings.title: Lien for repairing lessee or licensee personal property
headings.reviewNote: Grants mechanics, persons, or corporations a lien on a licensee's or lessee's fixtures, machinery, or personal property on licensed/leased lots for repair labor.

headings.title: Forfeited lease assignee rights and sixty-day removal
headings.reviewNote: Treats purchaser after lease forfeiture as assignee entitled to pay rent arrears, or grants sixty-day removal right with ground rent paid from sale proceeds if lessor regained possession earlier.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1909–1992 history note; fixed shifted/hallucinated titles and notes in subsections 3 (lessee personal-property repair lien) and 4 (forfeited-lease assignee rights and 60-day removal).

headings.title: Mandatory joinder of recorded lien claimants and owners
headings.reviewNote: Requires all recorded lien claimants, encumbrancers, owners, and lessees to be joined as plaintiffs or defendants.

headings.title: Binding effect on unrecorded claimants and intervention right
headings.reviewNote: Binds unrecorded claimants by proceedings while permitting intervention before final distribution of sale proceeds.

headings.title: Subsequent addition of omitted recorded parties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes omitted recorded parties to be added on own application, party application, or court motion.

headings.title: Party death and representative substitution without revivor
headings.reviewNote: Provides for substitution of proper successors or administrators on motion without formal action revivor upon party death.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1919–1939 revision history; confirmed mandatory joinder of recorded parties, binding/intervention rules for unrecorded claimants, adding omitted parties, and revivor-free substitution on death.

headings.title: Commercial real estate broker lien for listing representation
headings.reviewNote: Grants commercial broker lien pursuant to written listing agreement upon procuring ready, willing, and able buyer or lessee.

headings.title: Commercial real estate broker lien for buyer representation
headings.reviewNote: Grants commercial broker lien on commercial real estate pursuant to written buyer representation agreement upon earned compensation.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections, 1993 enactment note, and 1998 annotation (Incentive Realty v. Hawatmeh, 983 S.W.2d 156) applying broker liens to lease procurement; confirmed listing and buyer-representation broker lien headings.

headings.title: Petition contents and foreclosure under mortgage laws
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required broker lien foreclosure petition contents and governs proceedings under mortgage foreclosure statutes.

headings.title: Priority of prior recorded liens and mortgages
headings.reviewNote: Accords priority to valid prior recorded liens and mortgages over real estate broker's liens.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1993 enactment note; confirmed commercial broker lien foreclosure petition contents under §§ 443.190–443.280 and priority of valid prior recorded liens and mortgages.
